brief:
Hamas official Osama Hamdan stressed that national unity and adherence to Palestinian constants form the foundation for achieving peace, the Ma'an news agency reported. He emphasized the importance of Palestinians maintaining their core positions in any peace process.

Hamdan's statement reflects Hamas's stance on the conditions necessary for resolving the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, positioning Palestinian unity and unwavering commitment to core principles as prerequisites for successful negotiations.
title: Hamas leader calls national unity and Palestinian constants basis for peace
